project_access_events_shape.name: project_access_events_shape
project_access_events_shape.value:
(
        ("project_access_events"."type" = 'project_access_granted'
          and "project_access_events"."level" is not null and "project_access_events"."previous_level" is null)
        or ("project_access_events"."type" = 'project_access_level_changed'
          and "project_access_events"."level" is not null and "project_access_events"."previous_level" is not null)
        or ("project_access_events"."type" = 'project_access_revoked'
          and "project_access_events"."level" is null and "project_access_events"."previous_level" is not null)
      )

project_activity_target_matches_type.name: project_activity_target_matches_type

(
        ("project_activity"."type" in ('project_created', 'project_renamed', 'project_fallback_policy_changed', 'project_label_created', 'project_label_edited', 'project_label_deleted') and "project_activity"."issue_id" is null and "project_activity"."knowledge_entry_id" is null)
        or ("project_activity"."type" in ('issue_created', 'issue_edited', 'issue_commented', 'issue_review_handoff', 'issue_closed', 'issue_reopened', 'issue_dependency_added', 'issue_dependency_removed', 'issue_link_added', 'issue_link_removed', 'issue_question_asked', 'issue_question_answered', 'issue_question_paused', 'issue_question_fallback_used', 'issue_question_follow_up', 'issue_fallback_policy_override_changed', 'issue_stop_requested', 'issue_session_expired', 'issue_label_added', 'issue_label_removed', 'issue_parent_changed', 'issue_deleted', 'issue_restored') and "project_activity"."issue_id" is not null and "project_activity"."knowledge_entry_id" is null)
        or ("project_activity"."type" in ('knowledge_created', 'knowledge_edited', 'knowledge_deleted', 'knowledge_restored') and "project_activity"."issue_id" is null and "project_activity"."knowledge_entry_id" is not null)
      )

questions_resolution_matches_status.name: questions_resolution_matches_status
questions_resolution_matches_status.value:
(
        ("questions"."status" = 'open' and "questions"."answer" is null and "questions"."answered_by_human_id" is null
          and "questions"."answered_at" is null and "questions"."resolved_at" is null
          and "questions"."follow_up" is null and "questions"."follow_up_by_human_id" is null and "questions"."follow_up_at" is null)
        or ("questions"."status" = 'answered' and "questions"."answer" is not null and "questions"."answered_by_human_id" is not null
          and "questions"."answered_at" is not null and "questions"."resolved_at" is not null
          and "questions"."follow_up" is null and "questions"."follow_up_by_human_id" is null and "questions"."follow_up_at" is null)
        or ("questions"."status" in ('paused', 'fallback_used') and "questions"."answer" is null
          and "questions"."answered_by_human_id" is null and "questions"."answered_at" is null and "questions"."resolved_at" is not null
          and (("questions"."follow_up" is null and "questions"."follow_up_by_human_id" is null and "questions"."follow_up_at" is null)
            or ("questions"."follow_up" is not null and "questions"."follow_up_by_human_id" is not null and "questions"."follow_up_at" is not null)))
      )

          or ("runner_dispatches"."state" in ('active', 'uncertain') and "runner_dispatches"."accepted_at" is not null and "runner_dispatches"."run_id" is not null and "runner_dispatches"."work_session_id" is not null)
          or ("runner_dispatches"."state" = 'ended' and ((("runner_dispatches"."accepted_at" is not null) and ("runner_dispatches"."run_id" is not null) and ("runner_dispatches"."work_session_id" is not null))
            or (("runner_dispatches"."accepted_at" is null) and ("runner_dispatches"."run_id" is null) and ("runner_dispatches"."work_session_id" is null))))
